items.desc_now: 给 DSH 工作区一个用途维度：项目工作区注入项目约定，临时会话（$DSH_HOME/workspace/default，首次运行自动创建）注入『非项目』状态块。侧边栏底部一颗「临时会话」按钮 + 会话头用途徽标。dsh-plugin
items.desc_prev: Turns each DSH workspace folder into a project: auto-injects a compact project-workspace convention into every new session, with a per-session Project toggle in the composer. dsh-plugin
